Markdown draws list markers as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.s3d1)

A bullet is " • " in markdown.item.bullet (bold), a number is drawn with no
dot in markdown.item.number (cyan), right-aligned in a column sized for the
number one past the last item, as Rich's last_number sizes it; each hang is
in its marker's style and the item's body in markdown.item. An empty item is
counted and draws nothing. The parser records the list's start number and
leaves the drawing to the renderer.

Markdown draws an image ahead of its block, linked to an enclosing link, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.vke3) (#430)

* Markdown draws an image ahead of its block, linked to an enclosing link, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.vke3)

Rich's render loop draws an image the moment it meets one, ahead of the
top-level block holding it, and links the alt text to the link it sits in.
A list is now one token, so an image in any item is drawn ahead of the
whole list.

* Markdown image review: pin Rich 15's inline HTML, plain exit steps, docs line in words (rich-unfiled-791c.vke3)
